card.name: Boats and ships just before vessel words
card.fires_on: Small words and punctuation right after a boat or ship is mentioned or described, where a vessel word or name is likely next. Seen in travel, cruise and sailing text.

modes.label: After ship noun
modes.description: Comma or linking word right after a ship type such as cruise ship, before its name or description.
modes.example: the more than 4,000 passengers on the cruise ship<<,>> ironically named Triumph

modes.label: Boat travel phrasing
modes.description: Words in travel phrases about getting somewhere by boat, such as by, chartered, or hour before ferry.
modes.example: We went<< by>> catamaran, leaving from Pape

modes.label: Vessel measurements
modes.description: Size or hull descriptions leading to the word vessel or boat.

card.writes: It pushes toward ship and ferry words, including Chinese characters for ship and crossing, and tank or shipping terms.
card.plain: It lights up in text about boats and ships, just before the next word that names or describes the vessel.
